title: Softmax Cross-Entropy Gradient
prompt: For softmax + cross-entropy with logits z = [0, 0] and one-hot target y = [1, 0], the gradient is dL/dz = softmax(z) − y. Compute it as a column.
hint: the famous result dL/dz = p − y, with p = [1/2, 1/2]
recap: Softmax with cross-entropy has the famous gradient dL/dz = softmax(z) − y — predicted probabilities minus the one-hot truth.
